About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 


What You'll Do:
• 
Operational Rigor & Team Scaling: Guide the team's transition into a highly structured, queue-based enrollment model. Establish clear KPIs around enrollment conversion, schedule adherence, and capacity utilization. Level-set expectations and build a foundation of high performance, reliability, and trust.

• 
Tech & Systems Optimization: Act as the operational subject matter expert for our CRM. Proactively identify missing Salesforce fields, clunky workflows, and routing inefficiencies. Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that reduce friction and extend our tech stack.

• 
Real-Time Queue Management: Own daily frontline service delivery. Ensure outreach occurs within one business day and the inbound front door is consistently covered during operating hours. Monitor answer rates, SLA adherence, and daily staffing logistics to consistently hit volume targets.
